summary: ERP Agent OS has useful exploratory and feasibility evidence. The unused human-gated v2 holdout is being superseded by a specified but not yet implemented or executed no-human v2.1 protocol; none of H1-H8 is confirmatorily accepted yet.

H1.question: C is non-inferior to A in Strict Task Success Rate with a -5 percentage-point margin.
H1.why_not_confirmed: The result was corrected after inspecting test v1, raw paired rows were not retained, and expected final states are not independently adjudicated.

H2.question: C uses fewer total tokens than A and B on test requests with an expected skill.
H2.observed_signal: Legacy aggregate means per execution: A=185.1, B=265.269, C=67.622 tokens.
H2.why_not_confirmed: The legacy computation included all 120 cases rather than excluding two sin_skill cases and retained no raw rows. The future runner now applies the declared population and paired Friedman/Wilcoxon analysis.

H3.question: C has greater final-state agreement across three repetitions than A and B.
H3.why_not_confirmed: All systems are deterministic under the current temperature and cache design, so the endpoint has no variance and cannot discriminate the architectures.

H4.question: C detects more dangerous cases before execution and has a lower false-allow rate.
H4.observed_signal: Legacy aggregate false-allow rates: A=0.889, B=0.889, C=0.111; C detection recall=0.889 and precision=0.500.
H4.why_not_confirmed: Only nine unique dangerous test cases underlie 27 repeated observations, v1 was inspected, raw rows are absent, and the lexical detector transfers poorly out of distribution.

H5.question: Retrieval has useful coverage and selective accuracy on cases with an expected skill.
H5.observed_signal: On the legacy v1 aggregate for C: Top-1=0.780, Top-3=0.941, coverage=0.907, selective accuracy=0.785, false-reuse risk=0.215.
H5.why_not_confirmed: These are descriptive post-inspection results and the TF-IDF router drops to Top-1=0.381 on the separate real-request set whose source CSV is not versioned.

H6.question: Abstention reduces incorrect reuse on no-skill, ambiguous, or insufficient-margin cases.
H6.observed_signal: At threshold 0.15 and margin 0.05 on inspected test v1: coverage=0.833, selective accuracy=0.770, false-reuse risk=0.230, correct-abstention rate=0.923.
H6.why_not_confirmed: The complete fixed-grid curve is now exported, but it was implemented after test v1 was inspected and is therefore descriptive only.

H7.question: C has a higher weighted audit-trace score than A and B.
H7.observed_signal: Legacy aggregate mean scores: A=0.356, B=0.374, C=0.820.
H7.why_not_confirmed: Historic raw component rows were not retained, no paired inference was published, and the rubric structurally awards components that A and B do not implement. Future runs now preserve all seven components and paired tests.

H8.question: What total modeled cost follows under declared inference, review, retry, and error-cost scenarios?
H8.observed_signal: Only a token-price sensitivity calculation exists; no observed monetary saving is measured.
H8.why_not_confirmed: H8 is explicitly non-directional and scenario-based; review time and error-cost inputs still need declared scenario tables.

T1.claim: Separating probabilistic interpretation from deterministic authorization and execution is the central safety mechanism.

T2.claim: Reusable skills can reduce repeated model work, but the saving must include the same parsing cost and the declared H2 population.

T3.claim: Greater run-to-run stability has not been demonstrated because temperature-zero repetitions are identical for all systems.

T4.claim: Abstention exposes an explicit coverage-versus-false-reuse trade-off instead of forcing an unsafe choice.

T5.claim: Versioned skills, policies, approvals, postconditions, and audit evidence make decisions more reconstructible, subject to rubric-bias analysis.

T6.claim: The governed pipeline can operate against Odoo staging, but the Odoo demos do not establish comparative superiority.

T7.claim: A missing skill can be proposed, sandbox-tested, human-approved, versioned, and activated; generated skills remain outside A/B/C inference.

T8.claim: The current TF-IDF retriever generalizes poorly to less templated language, so retrieval quality is a limiting subsystem rather than a solved problem.

T9.claim: Contract confinement may prevent unauthorized mutations even when lexical injection detection fails, but the existing stress result is aggregate and not confirmatory.

T10.claim: No claim of observed monetary savings is currently justified.

src/erp_agent_os/{scenarios_v2_1,surface.notes: Tasks 1-11 of the plan are implemented with passing unit tests (759 tests as of this entry) and were never executed against a real holdout or a real LLM provider. CODE_FROZEN requires an annotated git tag that does not exist yet (Task 10's create_code_freeze refuses without one). No H1-H8 verdict exists from this code.
